notes.title: Update Notes for April 2023
notes.content: This update includes performance improvements, bug fixes and exciting upcoming mechanics for a more frantic gameplay.

notes.title: Update notes for October 15
notes.content:
[h1]In this update we have continued to tweak our game to make it better for you, these fixes include:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Expansion of the play area, new props, and houses introduced.
[*]Fixed some connectivity issues that occurred to some players during a match
[*]New VFX added no enemies
[/list]

Stay tuned! a bigger update is on its way

notes.title: Update notes for Sep. 10th, 2021
notes.content:
[h3]Hello guys, in this update we have continued to tweak our game to make it better for you, these fixes include:[/h3]

[olist]
[*]Fixed some materials that were not displaying correctly.
[*]Now Wayans have a 15% chance of spawning ammo when dead.
[*]Dynamic powerups spawn each round.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed players to use grenades while being dead.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update notes for August 7th, 2021
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello guys, in this update we have continued to tweak our game to make it better for you, this fixes include:
[/b][/h2]

Fixed bug which prevented some players from dying after being defeated for the second time
Fixed some inputs binding that was not working properly
Added current round on top of the display
Fixed head name blending with world objects
Minor bug fixes
